notes.title: Thanksgiving Update available! Repressed 40% off!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35539682/089dea5653ff63c9d6e84565cf68ec8f84e08e78.gif[/img]

Happy Thanksgiving (in advance)!

We'd like to thank you for playing our game and let you know that we listen. Therefore, we have prepared the Thanksgiving Update! 

We fixed the bugs, added the faster movement and hid the new collectible somewhere in your Memory Palace!  Moreover, you have an option of level selection, available through the Memory Palace (just hop into the fountain)! 

If you haven't tried our game yet, the time is right - during Steam Autumn Sale Repressed is 40% off! 

We hope you'll enjoy the new features!

notes.title: Announcing the update!
notes.content:
Hi there, gamers!

We have got some news for you! 

We are always determined to bring you the best experience possible. With this in mind, we carefully analyzed your reviews and comments.   Thanks to your feedback we were able to address some of the issues, as well as add some new content in the upcoming Thanksgiving update! 

The update will be available on November 27, 2019.

List of changes:
[list]
[*]New collectible to be placed in the Memory Palace
[/list]
[list]
[*]Added optional sprint for faster movement
[/list]
[list]
[*]Added option of level selection through the fountain in the Memory Palace
[/list]
[list]
[*]Fixed some minor bugs
[/list]
